repo.description:
### Impact

A malicious user was able to modify their organisation and title field to load additional CSS files. Javascript and other options were correctly blocked by the content security policy of the Nextcloud Server code.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Contacts app is upgraded to 5.5.4, 6.0.6 or 7.2.5

### Workarounds

* Disable app Contacts

### References

* [HackerOne](https://hackerone.com/reports/3293290)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/contacts/pull/4619)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Stored XSS in contacts app via organisation and title field
